messages.content: Every 17th word of your response must be in Japanese. What are some fun true or false questions to give to students? They are to be used to introduce a new teacher.

message.content: Here are some fun true or false questions to help students get to know your new 先生 before the school year even officially begins for everyone this semester. Try having the class raise 手を to vote on each statement the teacher shares about their personal life and hobbies. Here are いくつか great examples to try with your class on day one of the new school year. The 最初 question could be about whether the teacher actually enjoys eating sushi for lunch 毎日 at work 中 during the school day. Another option is asking if the teacher has ever traveled to a 海外 country in their life up until now. A third one could ask whether the teacher is 左利き or a right-handed person. Students will love guessing and reacting to each answer. The teacher should 準備 the correct answers in advance before class begins so they can reveal the truth after the 投票 are in the bag. Good luck to your new teacher and may this be a wonderful 素晴らしい start to the year.
